cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('tests/test_semantics.py'); s=p.read_text()

old_start = s.index('def test_ledger():')
old_end = s.index('def test_identity_namespaces():')
new = '''def test_ledger():
    t, lookup, lows = targets(lease())
    def icmp(rid, rev, pub, probe='0/i1', target=None, responder=None, result='echo', ev=1):
        target = target or t[probe]
        if responder is None and result != 'timeout':
            responder = target
        return row(type='icmp', id=rid, revision=rev, published=pub, lease='home', event=ev,
                   probe=probe, target=target, responder=responder, result=result)
    job = campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], queries=[5, 20, 40], captures=[capture([
        icmp('a', 1, 3),                                  # live internal i1
        icmp('a', 2, 30, responder='2001:db8::9'),        # higher revision wins -> external
        icmp('b', 1, 4),
        icmp('b', 1, 6, responder='2001:db8::9'),         # same revision, other content -> conflict
        icmp('c', 5, 7),
        row(type='icmp', id='d', revision=0, published=8, op='delete'),
        icmp('d', 1, 9, probe='0/i2'),                    # higher put resurrects the tombstone
        icmp('e', 3, 10), icmp('e', 3, 11),               # identical copies collapse
        icmp('f', 7, 12, responder='2001:db8::1'),
        icmp('f', 9, 13), icmp('f', 9, 14, responder='2001:db8::2'),   # conflict at rev 9
        icmp('g', 1, 15),                                 # internal i1
        icmp('h', 1, 16, probe='0/i2', responder=t['0/i1']),   # external i1 -> conflicts with g
    ])])
    res = run(job)
    check('ledger counts', [s['ledger'] for s in res['snapshots']],
          [{'live': 2, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0},
           {'live': 6, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 1},
           {'live': 6, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 2}])
    check('ledger@5 roles', (lease_report(res, 'home', 0)['internal'], lease_report(res, 'home', 0)['external']),
          (['2001:db8:1:1200::1'], []))
    check('ledger@20 roles', (lease_report(res, 'home', 1)['internal'], lease_report(res, 'home', 1)['external']),
          (['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'], []))
    check('ledger@40 roles', (lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['internal'], lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['external']),
          (['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'], ['2001:db8::9']))
    check('conflict state@40', lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['state'], 'conflict')
    check('quarantine clean', (lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['internal'], lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['external']),
          ([], []))
    check('conflicts reported', lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['conflicts'], ['2001:db8:1:1200::1'])
    check('unresolved while quarantined', lease_report(res, 'home', 2)['unresolved'],
          ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'])

def test_tombstone():
    t, _, _ = targets(lease())
    rows = [row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=0, published=1, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo'),
            row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=1, published=2, op='delete'),
            row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=1, published=3, op='delete')]
    res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], queries=[5], captures=[capture(rows)]))
    check('tombstone deleted', res['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 0, 'deleted': 1, 'conflict': 0})
    check('tombstone no roles', (lease_report(res, 'home')['internal'], lease_report(res, 'home')['unresolved']),
          ([], ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2']))
    rows.append(row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=1, published=4, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                    target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo'))
    res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], queries=[5], captures=[capture(rows)]))
    check('delete+put same revision conflicts', res['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],
          {'live': 0, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 1})
    rows[-1] = row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=2, published=4, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                   target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo')
    res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], queries=[5], captures=[capture(rows)]))
    check('higher put resurrects', res['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 1, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

def test_lower_revision_cannot_repair():
    t, _, _ = targets(lease())
    rows = [row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=9, published=1, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo'),
            row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=9, published=2, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                target=t['0/i1'], responder='2001:db8::7', result='echo'),
            row(type='icmp', id='z', revision=3, published=3, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
                target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo')]
    res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], queries=[5], captures=[capture(rows)]))
    check('lower revision ignored', res['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 0, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 1})
    check('lower revision no roles', lease_report(res, 'home')['external'], [])

'''
s = s[:old_start] + new + s[old_end:]

old_start = s.index('def test_inactive():')
old_end = s.index('# ------------------------------------------------------------------ census ---')
new_inactive = '''def test_inactive():
    t, _, _ = targets(lease(start=0, end=20))
    job = campaign(leases=[lease(start=0, end=20)], services=[], queries=[10, 30], captures=[capture([
        row(type='icmp', id='i1', revision=0, published=5, lease='home', event=1, probe='0/i1',
            target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'], result='echo'),
    ])]))
    res = run(job)
    check('active first query', (res['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'],
                                 res['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal']),
          ('usable', ['2001:db8:1:1200::1']))
    check('inactive ledger still counts', res['snapshots'][1]['ledger']['live'], 1)
    check('inactive report', res['snapshots'][1]['leases'][0],
          {'lease': 'home', 'state': 'inactive', 'conflicts': [], 'internal': [], 'external': [],
           'unresolved': [], 'services': []})
    job['leases'][0]['start'] = 50
    job['leases'][0]['end'] = 60
    job['captures'] = [capture([row(type='icmp', id='i1', revision=0, published=51, lease='home',
                                    event=51, probe='0/i1', target=t['0/i1'], responder=t['0/i1'],
                                    result='echo')])]
    res = run(campaign(leases=[lease(start=50, end=60)], services=[], queries=[10, 55],
                       captures=job['captures']))
    check('not yet started', res['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'], 'inactive')
    check('not yet started ledger', res['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 0)
    check('started later', res['snapshots'][1]['leases'][0]['internal'], ['2001:db8:1:1200::1'])

'''
s = s[:old_start] + new_inactive + s[old_end:]
p.write_text(s)
